solutions.title: Recursive child swap
solutions.strategy: Swap each node's children and recursively invert the subtrees.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The recursion stack grows with tree height h.

solutions.title: Iterative stack swap
solutions.strategy: Use an explicit stack to visit nodes and swap children in place.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every non-null node is popped once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The stack stores pending nodes and can grow with tree height on skewed trees.
